set.body: Demonstrate a scientifically meaningful unequal-axis effect form rather than a square toy. Use distinct named left and right experimental spaces, permit unequal or missing items, encode a match/control coupling plus at least one pair-space covariate, and declare operation order. Acceptance: public runnable analysis through existing general APIs, independent numerical oracle, no method-specific er_rsa_model abstraction, explicit axis and generalization identities, and a clear statement of what is awkward or lossy in a principal square shared-pattern RDM representation.
set.title: Gate 3: ship a real rectangular cross-domain analysis
